items.title: Proofpoint lines up $6.3 billion deal for Varonis’ data security
items.summary: Cybersecurity giant Proofpoint says it will acquire Miami-based data visibility and security company Varonis in an all-cash transaction worth $6.3 billion.

items.title: Moscow police detain suspected DataSuckers hackers linked to breaches in Ukraine and Russia
items.summary: Russian authorities have reportedly detained three suspected members of the DataSuckers hacking group following a cyberattack on a popular restaurant chain that exposed vast amounts of customer information.

items.title: Baltimore suburb confirms August data breach after ransomware claims
items.summary: Anne Arundel County, Maryland, said an intruder stole files from government systems, and investigators are working to assess how much data was exposed.

items.title: Suspected Chinese espionage attackers abusing BeyondTrust IT support zero-day
items.summary: An alleged Chinese state-backed group is using a new zero-day affecting BeyondTrust IT support software to conduct espionage attacks.

items.title: Federal bankruptcy courts dealing with outages after contractor cyberattack
items.summary: The incident, which involved a government contractor, has halted all production of bankruptcy notices.
